kebab_example: aliyun ehpcinstant list-jobs --page-size 50 --page-number 1 --filter '{"Status":"Running","TimeCreatedBefore":1703820113,"JobName":"testJob","JobIds":["example-string"],"JobId":"job-xxxx","TimeCreatedAfter":1703819914}' --sort-by Order=ASC Label=time_start --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListJobs

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 50. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的本页条数。 默认50，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The current page number.

Start value: 1

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

fields.help_en: The name of the job. Fuzzy search is supported
fields.help_zh: 作业名称。支持模糊查询
fields.name: job_name

fields.help_en: The time after which the jobs were submitted. This is a UNIX timestamp based on the local time of the region. For sites in the Chinese mainland, the time zone is UTC+8
fields.help_zh: 在此时间之后提交的作业，以所在地域的时间转化为（中国内地为东八区）Unix时间戳
fields.name: time_created_after

fields.help_en: The time before which the jobs were submitted. This is a UNIX timestamp based on the local time of the region. For sites in the Chinese mainland, the time zone is UTC+8
fields.help_zh: 在此时间之前提交的作业，以所在地域的时间转化为（中国内地为东八区）Unix时间戳
fields.name: time_created_before

fields.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

Pending: The job is in the queue.

Initing: The job is initializing.

Succeeded: The job was successful.

Failed: The job failed.

Running: The job is running.

Exception: A scheduling exception occurred.

Retrying: The job is being retried.

Expired: The job timed out.

Suspended: The job is in hibernation.

Restarting: The job is restarting.

Deleted: The job is deleted
fields.help_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

Pending：作业排队中
Initing：作业初始化中
Succeeded：作业运行成功
Failed：作业运行失败
Running：作业运行中
Exception：调度异常
Retrying：作业重试中
Expired：作业超时
Suspended：作业休眠
Restarting：作业重启中
Deleted：作业删除完成
fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for querying jobs
parameters.name: filter

fields.help_en:
The field to sort by. Valid values:

time_start

job_name
fields.help_zh:
排序标签。取值范围：

time_start
job_name
fields.name: label

fields.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

ASC (default): Ascending

DESC: Descending
fields.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值范围：

ASC（默认值）：升序
DESC：降序
fields.name: order
